title: Relative Binary-Path Config Loading
pattern: Loading configuration files using relative file paths starting from the current working directory of the caller.
why_bad: Fails instantly if the binary is executed from a different directory (e.g. systemd startup, cron jobs, or multi-directory pipelines), leading to crash loops or silent default fallbacks.
detection: Using standard file opening functions with raw relative literal strings (like `"config.json"`) instead of fully qualified, absolute paths.
fix: Expose configuration paths via environment variables or CLI options, always resolving them into absolute file paths before opening.
source: [Pragmatic Programmers] Michael T. Nygard - *Release It!_ Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software* (2007, Pragmatic Bookshelf).pdf, Section 14.2.
